summary: Apogee Enterprises filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Merger Agreement to acquire Keller Companies (KCI), controlling shareholder of Kalwall Corporation and Structures Unlimited Inc., for a cash purchase price of approximately $105 million, subject to customary adjustments for closing cash, debt, and working capital. Sellers may receive up to an additional $10 million earn-out based on KCI's fiscal year ending November 28, 2026. Approximately $9.5 million will be held in escrows for post-closing adjustments and indemnification. The transaction is expected to close upon satisfaction of customary conditions including absence of prohibitory laws and no Company Material Adverse Effect. Apogee will finance the acquisition with cash on hand and existing credit facility. Watch for regulatory clearance and any competing bids.
